notes.title: Cloud Saves, Easter Story Branch, and Chinese Voiceover!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133990/badef4a7547f0d6cc8f5f40ecf615f950d3d746a.png[/img]

Hey everyone!
Thanks a lot for tuning in!
Today I'm excited to bring you another game update — hope you enjoy it!

✨ What's new:

[list]
[*] Save system is finally here! It's still in beta, so expect a few bumps — testing and polish are ongoing. Cloud saves should be working too!
[*] Added an Easter story branch! It's short but ends with a full-fledged ending. XD
[*] Chinese voiceover! AI-generated, but still cool. Huge thanks to my Chinese buddy 作死 for the invaluable help with the translation!
[*] And a bunch of smaller fixes and tweaks XD
[/list]

Have fun!
Big hugs and high lifts ❤️

notes.title: Italian Voiceover, Outfits and More...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133990/05c6fe84dbefd7a7a79677ca68aa4ac817f4c0a2.png[/img]
Sup!
We've finally finished developing the outfits, and now they're ready!

[list]
[*] Outfits and accessories now display correctly when looking down and in cutscenes.
[*] Sexyest Italian voiceover (thanks to Erixstudio).
[*] Improved gamepad controls. Now you can play almost perfectly on the Steam Deck.
[*] Removed the Linux version. Too many things don't work as they should, and even more don't work at all. Proton handles the Windows version flawlessly!
[*] Snow has been removed, but the Christmas's quest is still there. It will move to the upcoming "New Game+" mode in the future.
[*] A ton of optimizations.
[*] A couple of new hidden fun things—hard to find, but possible!
[/list]

Have fun! <3
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144590/Dogoni_menya_Vitalik/

notes.title: New year update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133990/525dc09b9bbac8287539576237b81703601ed0d1.png[/img]
Sup!
We've got the New Year's update ready!
Some highlights:
[list]
[*] We've made the character skin change system. Now we can make custom outfits!
[*] A New Year's quest to lift your spirits :)
[*] Gamepad controls fixed. If you've used a gamepad before, I recommend resetting the control settings to "default"
[*] You can now slap Vitaly to his juicy ass!
[*] Stats at the end of each run + global statistics
[*] Censorship for my Chinese friends!
[*] Localization of certain things for non-CIS players
[*] A bit of optimization. Might not be noticeable due to the snowy weather:)
[*] And various minor tweaks
[/list]

Love you all in a gay way!
Happy New Year!

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133990/b34c8fc98a9a32c2ac4dfd876598fdd1c9e4d74c.png[/img]
Sup! What's new:
[olist]
[*] Fixed UI for ultra-wide monitors
[*] Added money. For now, it's just for bragging rights and to help new players understand that they need to check EVERY locker :) In the future, we'll let you buy cool stuff with it.
[*] Optimized cutscenes—at least, I hope so :)
[*] Added proper Japanese text translation by Hiroshi Ashida
[*] Added proper Italian text translation by Erixstudio. They're also working on full voice-over
[*] Fixed the door on the bobblehead stand—it didn't always open before
[*] A bunch of minor tweaks here and there
[/olist]

Have fun! <3

notes.title: Asian Languages
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133990/3019a50c1a5a46d53d6d7d4a4594244a519a93bf.png[/img]
[h3]This is a post for our Asian friends.
I noticed that the game is being sold in China, but there are a lot of refunds coming from there.
So, I decided to improve the translation into Asian languages using ChatGPT
(previously, it was done with Google Translate).
That's it :)[/h3]

notes.title: Fast-o-Fix 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133990/b34c8fc98a9a32c2ac4dfd876598fdd1c9e4d74c.png[/img]
Sup!
Here's what got fixed:

[list]
[*] While difficulty settings are in progress, I made Vitaly less annoying.
[*] Fixed a bug with the car collider that made it impossible to pick up the key.
[*] Temporarily disabled the door by the boubbleheads stand.
[*] Potential fix for the safe issue in Nightmare mode. 
[*] Possible fix for lag on high-performance PCs (the game now logs less). 
[*] Music no longer stops if you exit to the menu and restart the game. 
[*] Various minor tweaks. 
[/list]

Available for Win 64, Win 32, and Mac. Linux coming tomorrow (taking a bit longer to build).

Enjoy! XD
